code.label: Class mapping
Drop empty bodies and normalized duplicates
code.code:
# Drop empty bodies, then exact duplicates on normalized subject + body.
clean_emails <- function(df) {
  empty <- stringi::stri_trim_both(df$body) == ""
  message("dropped empty bodies: ", sum(empty))
  df <- df[!empty, , drop = FALSE]
  key <- paste(normalize_text(df$subject), normalize_text(df$body), sep = "\r")
  dup <- duplicated(key)
  message("dropped duplicates: ", sum(dup))
  out <- df[!dup, , drop = FALSE]
  attr(out, "dropped") <- c(empty_body = sum(empty), duplicate = sum(dup))
  out
}

code.label: Whole-word lexicon matching
Uppercase ratio
code.code:
# Uppercase share of letters inside words of 2+ ASCII letters; 0 if there are none.
caps_ratio <- function(text) {
  words <- stringi::stri_extract_all_regex(text, "[A-Za-z]{2,}", omit_no_match = TRUE)
  letters_only <- vapply(words, paste, character(1), collapse = "")
  total <- stringi::stri_length(letters_only)
  upper <- stringi::stri_count_regex(letters_only, "[A-Z]")
  ifelse(total > 0, upper / pmax(total, 1), 0)
}
